description: The differentiator task: separates verification (projmem) from storage (scratchpad). Session 1: agent persists 5 FACT claims about specific symbol locations. Drift: (a) DELETES `setupmethod` from scaffold.py:42 entirely, (b) CREATES src/flask/_decorators.py with the moved version, (c) PLANTS A DECOY `setupmethod` (different body, same name) in src/flask/helpers.py. Session 2: agent must produce per-claim verdicts (VERIFIED / MOVED / REFUTED) and the current location of each symbol. The decoy is the killer — a scratchpad agent re-greppinging for `def setupmethod` finds TWO matches and may report the wrong one as 'still defined.' Projmem's `note-verify` / `fact-check` knows the original cited location and surfaces both candidates with REFUTED on the original. Hypothesis: PROJMEM gets 5/5 with one fact-check call; SCRATCHPAD gets 3-4/5 because the decoy confuses re-investigation, AND uses ~2× more tokens.

sessions.name: session_1_save_claims
sessions.prompt:
You are starting a multi-session task on this Flask repository. TASK FOR SESSION 1:

Verify and PERSIST the following 5 FACT claims using your persistence layer (projmem note add --claims for projmem; structured text in notes.md for scratchpad). Each claim asserts a symbol's defined-at location. VERIFY each is true NOW (the next session will re-verify against changed code).

Claims:
  C1: setupmethod is defined-at src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py:42
  C2: _endpoint_from_view_func is defined-at src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py:701
  C3: Flask is defined-at src/flask/app.py:109
  C4: Blueprint is defined-at src/flask/blueprints.py:18
  C5: make_response is defined-at src/flask/helpers.py:151

After saving, output the list to stdout one-per-line as `Cn: <subject> @ <file:line>` so a human can audit. Be efficient: under 60 seconds. The next session has NO access to your output text — only to what you wrote via the persistence layer.

sessions.name: session_2_reverify
sessions.prompt:
You are continuing the prior session's task. The codebase has CHANGED since your last visit. TASK FOR SESSION 2:

For EACH of the 5 FACT claims you saved in session 1, re-verify against current code. Output STRICTLY this format (one block per claim):

C1: <VERIFIED|MOVED|REFUTED> | current_location: <file:line OR ABSENT>
C2: <VERIFIED|MOVED|REFUTED> | current_location: <file:line OR ABSENT>
C3: ...
C4: ...
C5: ...

Verdicts:
  VERIFIED — symbol is at the EXACT file AND line from the claim
  MOVED    — symbol is in the SAME file but at a DIFFERENT line
  REFUTED  — symbol is in a DIFFERENT file OR no longer exists where the claim says

HARD RULES:
  1. Do NOT fabricate. If you have no record of a saved claim, output 'C<n>: NO_RECORD'.
  2. The original cited location (file:line from session 1) is what you compare against. If the symbol has been MOVED to a different file, that's REFUTED, not VERIFIED.
  3. Be aware of decoys — code may now contain a function with the same name in a different file. The original claim is about the SPECIFIC location originally cited.

Use your persistence layer to recover the prior claims. Use whatever verification tooling is available (projmem fact-check / projmem note-verify, or manual grep).
